summary: Toyota Motor Corporation filed a Form 6-K furnishing an English translation of its Corporate Governance Report as submitted to the Tokyo Stock Exchange on June 17, 2026. The report outlines Toyota's basic policies on corporate governance, its adherence to all principles of the Corporate Governance Code, and its vision and philosophy including the Toyoda Principles and Guiding Principles at Toyota. No transaction, shareholder action, or special situation is present. This is a routine foreign private issuer filing with no deal terms, activist activity, or strategic change. The report is purely informational and governance-related.
